game_concept: A racing platformer set in Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall, a hall of wandering spirits: the scholar mage must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Reverse Parade: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall: a hall of wandering spirits
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare float: declare resource as float, apply resource + 10.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 10 starts with [-3, 0, 17, 20]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Parade' (Week 7 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Spirit Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ancient lock by solving code steps involving parade_ok that move the scholar mage forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the ancient lock first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Declare before use. float resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %.1f.
